content.body: Anyone else seeing GitHub errors accessing specific issues?

I can't access https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10673 when logged in, and neither can a collegue. It works fine under a different GitHub account or incognito/inprivate. I'm able to access other issues fine.

I am trying to reach out to a GitHub employee internally to see if there's anything we can do here, but I am wondering if there's something to do with this repo specifically or my account that's causing it.
